summary: Revision 1 preserves the complete F-01–18 product goal and truthfully limits this increment to a synthetic local desktop shell. The unresolved additional-OS answer need not block a reversible macOS-only increment. Two execution gaps require correction: the existing renderer depends on browser pairing/bearer HTTP transport without an owned migration task, and packaged security/lifecycle verification is weaker than the bound ADR-0002 requirements.

open_findings.title: Define the renderer transport adaptation and its owned files
open_findings.evidence: Step 3 reuses the existing Vite renderer while line 37 restricts engineer ownership to desktop-shell and manifests/config. Existing WorkbenchPage imports pairWithBridge/readSyntheticFixture/heartbeatBridge/revokeBridge and keeps capabilityRef; read-synthetic-fixture.ts performs bearer-authenticated HTTP requests. The desktop contract instead requires a named preload surface and no renderer bridge bearer token. No task specifies how this existing connection state and transport will be replaced or adapted.
open_findings.impact: Loading the existing app alone presents a browser-pairing workflow rather than a working supervised desktop bridge flow. An engineer must either exceed the stated file ownership, leave the synthetic bridge disconnected, or invent an integration mechanism at the trust boundary.
open_findings.required_correction: Record a concrete desktop renderer integration choice before handoff: a separately owned desktop composition that reuses presentational workbench components, or an explicit transport-injection refactor with the affected workbench/shared files added to ownership. State the named operations and startup/error/restart mapping, and require an end-to-end assertion that the displayed snapshot/events came through the owned utility/main/preload path without browser pairing or bearer credentials in the renderer. Preserve browser regression coverage if shared files change.

open_findings.title: Bind packaged security and failure lifecycle checks to required commands
open_findings.evidence: desktop-e2e explicitly launches only the dev app. desktop-package-smoke at line 180 requires packaged launch and ordinary exit/child cleanup only. ADR-0002 explicitly requires packaged sender/frame, navigation, renderer privilege and preview checks, close/quit/crash/timeout/restart behavior, and inspection of the packaged renderer bundle for forbidden authority. Plan completion claims ADR alignment but the exact check contract does not require this packaged coverage.
open_findings.impact: All named checks could satisfy their declared scopes while a packaged-only origin, preload, asset, CSP or crash/restart cleanup defect remains untested. A successful startup smoke cannot establish the promised packaged boundary.
open_findings.required_correction: Expand the required packaged check or add a required packaged E2E target covering sender/frame and malformed payload rejection, navigation/window-open denial, privilege absence, preview isolation, startup failure, close/quit/restart/crash/timeout cleanup with observed owned child exits, and packaged bundle inspection. Bind these checks to D-2 and D-3, identify owned synthetic failure-injection fixtures, and require the checked artifact digest to match the delivered artifact.
